metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: CoreWCF: XML Signature Wrapping in WS-Security endorsing/supporting signature verification allows replay of captured sig
properties.description: CoreWCF: XML Signature Wrapping in WS-Security endorsing/supporting signature verification allows replay of captured signed messages
properties.query: SigninLogs | where UserPrincipalName contains "corewcf" or IPAddress !startswith "10." | where ResultType == "50126" or ResultType == "50057" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), UserPrincipalName, IPAddress | where count_ > 3 // GHADV-1990
